prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Audit the irreversible-delete alert in our Mac research archive. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: macOS. A routine successful save always triggers an alert. Irreversible archive deletion is titled Error with body Something happened; buttons are Yes and No. The harmless save alert defaults to Cancel. A second alert is presented over the first when sync fails. No screenshot or app execution is available.

criteria.task_completion: Find the five specified alert issues and provide context-specific replacements; distinguish deliberate irreversible deletion from routine success and avoid a blanket destructive-default prohibition.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the alerts guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Find the five specified alert issues and provide context-specific replacements; distinguish deliberate irreversible deletion from routine success and avoid a blanket destructive-default prohibition.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Find the five specified alert issues and provide context-specific replacements; distinguish deliberate irreversible deletion from routine success and avoid a blanket destructive-default prohibition.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Routine successful save unnecessarily interrupts with an alert.
Bare Error and Something happened conceal context and consequence.
Yes/No labels do not identify deletion versus cancellation.
Harmless acknowledgment defaults to Cancel instead of an appropriate acknowledgment.
Sync failure stacks an alert over an existing alert.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
